_doc: T.M4 (proof:stage-inventory) — the per-scene owner-sanctioned on-stage element manifest index. The INVERSE of the DFA: instead of 'the control set equals the table', assert 'the on-stage element set equals the owner-sanctioned inventory', so extra chrome NOT in the manifest REDs. This is the negative-space gate that catches the entire never-gated Class D ('no gate can assert this element should not exist'). Each scene's `manifest` slot is either an owner-sanctioned inventory file (docs/tranches/T/stage-manifests/<scene>.json) or the string 'EMPTY-RED' (born-RED — the band that rebuilds the scene fills it WITH owner sign-off, T.M4 lockstep). A scene whose manifest is EMPTY-RED, or whose retire-target chrome is un-manifested, REDs. Blessed prototype scenes (P-HERO/P-PANEL/P-THEME + the VERDICT removals) may carry a derivable skeleton NOW; T.A/T.B/T.C/T.D rebuild the rest.
